label: Figure 5.1: A supply curve for bicycles
alt: Upward-sloping supply curve for bicycles: quantity supplied rises from 1,000 to 2,000 a month as the price rises from $150 to $250.
caption: The supply curve S for bicycles slopes upward. At $150 producers supply 1,000 bicycles a month; when the price rises to $250 they supply 2,000. The curve gets steeper at higher prices, although economists usually draw supply curves as straight lines for simplicity.
